package handler

import (
	"errors"
	db "example.com/mmorpg-practice/db"
	"github.com/tjbdwanghaibo/roost-core/framework/entity"
)

type IMMOEntity interface {
	entity.IThreadSafeEntity
	Dao() *db.PlayerDao
}
type IMMOSceneEntity interface {
	entity.IThreadSafeEntity
	Dao() *db.SceneDao
}

var errMMORule = errors.New("mmorpg practice: stale request or business rejection")

// 两人队伍的业务样例；权限、队长和人数上限由正式游戏定义。
//
//roost:nest rollback=undo durability=strict
func handlerMMORPGParty(target IMMOEntity, peer IMMOEntity, partyID int64) error {
	if target.ID() == peer.ID() || partyID <= 0 {
		return errMMORule
	}
	if target.Dao().GetPartyID() != 0 && target.Dao().GetPartyID() != partyID {
		return errMMORule
	}
	if peer.Dao().GetPartyID() != 0 && peer.Dao().GetPartyID() != partyID {
		return errMMORule
	}
	target.Dao().SetPartyID(partyID)
	peer.Dao().SetPartyID(partyID)
	return nil
}

// 同进程切图：持久归属与场景人数一起提交。版本拒绝旧请求；AOI 订阅在提交后另行切换。
//
//roost:nest rollback=undo durability=strict
func handlerMMORPGTransfer(target IMMOEntity, from IMMOSceneEntity, to IMMOSceneEntity, version int64, reject bool) error {
	d := target.Dao()
	if from.ID() == to.ID() || version <= 0 {
		return errMMORule
	}
	if d.GetSceneVersion() == version && d.GetSceneID() == to.ID() {
		return nil
	}
	if d.GetSceneVersion() != version-1 || d.GetSceneID() != from.ID() || from.Dao().GetOccupants() <= 0 || to.Dao().GetOccupants() >= 100 {
		return errMMORule
	}
	from.Dao().SetOccupants(from.Dao().GetOccupants() - 1)
	to.Dao().SetOccupants(to.Dao().GetOccupants() + 1)
	d.SetSceneID(to.ID())
	d.SetSceneVersion(version)
	if reject {
		return errMMORule
	}
	return nil
}

// 串行单笔转账演示：单调序号与对手、金额绑定。旧交易拒绝，最新交易同身份重放成功。
// 不是通用交易账本；确认窗口、物品交换和长期查询由业务建模。
//
//roost:nest rollback=undo durability=strict
func handlerMMORPGTrade(target IMMOEntity, peer IMMOEntity, seq int64, amount int64, reject bool) error {
	d, p := target.Dao(), peer.Dao()
	if target.ID() == peer.ID() || seq <= 0 || amount <= 0 {
		return errMMORule
	}
	if seq == d.GetTradeSeq() {
		if d.GetTradeBuyer() == peer.ID() && d.GetTradeAmount() == amount {
			return nil
		}
		return errMMORule
	}
	if seq-1 != d.GetTradeSeq() || d.GetGold() < amount || p.GetGold() > 1000000-amount {
		return errMMORule
	}
	d.SetGold(d.GetGold() - amount)
	p.SetGold(p.GetGold() + amount)
	d.SetTradeSeq(seq)
	d.SetTradeBuyer(peer.ID())
	d.SetTradeAmount(amount)
	if reject {
		return errMMORule
	}
	return nil
}
